units.rawText: Listen well to what Zion's going to say!
units.displayText: Listen well to what Zion's going to say!

spans.text: Listen well to what Zion's going to say!

spans.text: [｡◕ᴗ◕｡ Is it new work?]

units.rawText: [O(∩_∩)O New work, new work!]
units.displayText: [O(∩_∩)O New work, new work!]

spans.text: [O(∩_∩)O New work, new work!]

units.rawText: Reactor 1... diagnosis report... sent to terminals. Identify and repair... according to... defect manual.
units.displayText: Reactor 1... diagnosis report... sent to terminals. Identify and repair... according to... defect manual.

spans.text: Reactor 1... diagnosis report... sent to terminals. Identify and repair... according to... defect manual.

units.rawText: [\(^o^)/~ Yay! New work! Repair reactor!]
units.displayText: [\(^o^)/~ Yay! New work! Repair reactor!]

spans.text: [\(^o^)/~ Yay! New work! Repair reactor!]

units.rawText: Proceed with caution... if there are uncertainties... report in.
units.displayText: Proceed with caution... if there are uncertainties... report in.

spans.text: Proceed with caution... if there are uncertainties... report in.

units.rawText: [｡◕ᴗ◕｡ Will there be chocolates?]
units.displayText: [｡◕ᴗ◕｡ Will there be chocolates?]

spans.text: [｡◕ᴗ◕｡ Will there be chocolates?]

units.rawText: [O(∩_∩)O There will, right?!]
units.displayText: [O(∩_∩)O There will, right?!]

spans.text: [O(∩_∩)O There will, right?!]

units.rawText: Ahh... I hate to say it, but Choco only has this one piece left on her.
units.displayText: Ahh... I hate to say it, but Choco only has this one piece left on her.

spans.text: Ahh... I hate to say it, but Choco only has this one piece left on her.

units.rawText: [＞﹏＜ No more chocolate...]
units.displayText: [＞﹏＜ No more chocolate...]

spans.text: [＞﹏＜ No more chocolate...]

units.rawText: The Chocolaterie was destroyed when the Entropics invaded. Choco would love to make more sweets for everyone, but there are no materials to speak of... Choco wants to help everyone, too.
units.displayText: The Chocolaterie was destroyed when the Entropics invaded. Choco would love to make more sweets for everyone, but there are no materials to speak of... Choco wants to help everyone, too.

spans.text: The Chocolaterie was destroyed when the Entropics invaded. Choco would love to make more sweets for everyone, but there are no materials to speak of... Choco wants to help everyone, too.

units.rawText: [｡◕ᴗ◕｡ If we help fix up the Chocolaterie, we'll have chocolates to eat.]
units.displayText: [｡◕ᴗ◕｡ If we help fix up the Chocolaterie, we'll have chocolates to eat.]

spans.text: [｡◕ᴗ◕｡ If we help fix up the Chocolaterie, we'll have chocolates to eat.]

units.rawText: [(¯﹃¯) Chocolates, chocolates!]
units.displayText: [(¯﹃¯) Chocolates, chocolates!]

spans.text: [(¯﹃¯) Chocolates, chocolates!]

units.rawText: No, no, you have to fix the reactor first. The reactor's important.
units.displayText: No, no, you have to fix the reactor first. The reactor's important.

spans.text: No, no, you have to fix the reactor first. The reactor's important.

units.rawText: [(〃'▽'〃) But I want chocolate...]
units.displayText: [(〃'▽'〃) But I want chocolate...]

spans.text: [(〃'▽'〃) But I want chocolate...]

units.rawText: Ms. Choco, zzp... with more hands, the work will be finished sooner. With the leftover time, we will be able to restore the Chocolaterie as well.
units.displayText: Ms. Choco, zzp... with more hands, the work will be finished sooner. With the leftover time, we will be able to restore the Chocolaterie as well.

spans.text: Ms. Choco, zzp... with more hands, the work will be finished sooner. With the leftover time, we will be able to restore the Chocolaterie as well.

units.rawText: The Oasis' technology should prove helpful in the repair process. Come, Mr. Penumbra, we shall assist as well.
units.displayText: The Oasis' technology should prove helpful in the repair process. Come, Mr. Penumbra, we shall assist as well.

spans.text: The Oasis' technology should prove helpful in the repair process. Come, Mr. Penumbra, we shall assist as well.

units.rawText: Tsk...
units.displayText: Tsk...

spans.text: Tsk...

units.rawText: Helping was the original intention, but the little guys seem to summon flowery VFX out of thin air whenever they speak. The air is enriched with a feeling of liveliness, and he has no clue how to interact with such beings.
units.displayText: Helping was the original intention, but the little guys seem to summon flowery VFX out of thin air whenever they speak. The air is enriched with a feeling of liveliness, and he has no clue how to interact with such beings.

spans.text: Helping was the original intention, but the little guys seem to summon flowery VFX out of thin air whenever they speak. The air is enriched with a feeling of liveliness, and he has no clue how to interact with such beings.

units.rawText: Do you agree, Penumbra?
units.displayText: Do you agree, Penumbra?

spans.text: Do you agree, Penumbra?

units.rawText: Sure.
units.displayText: Sure.

spans.text: Sure.

units.rawText: Yay! That's great~
units.displayText: Yay! That's great~

spans.text: Yay! That's great~

units.rawText: [(￣ˇ￣) We'll have chocolates soon!]
units.displayText: [(￣ˇ￣) We'll have chocolates soon!]

spans.text: [(￣ˇ￣) We'll have chocolates soon!]

units.rawText: [(/≧▽≦/) Soon, soon!]
units.displayText: [(/≧▽≦/) Soon, soon!]

spans.text: [(/≧▽≦/) Soon, soon!]

units.rawText: We should prepare and get going, then!
units.displayText: We should prepare and get going, then!

spans.text: We should prepare and get going, then!

units.rawText: Choco passes the singular remaining piece of chocolate to the robots. Their leader accepts it, carefully dividing it into three pieces.
units.displayText: Choco passes the singular remaining piece of chocolate to the robots. Their leader accepts it, carefully dividing it into three pieces.

spans.text: Choco passes the singular remaining piece of chocolate to the robots. Their leader accepts it, carefully dividing it into three pieces.

units.rawText: The three little beings, overflowing with happiness, make their way towards the reactor with haste and begin working.
units.displayText: The three little beings, overflowing with happiness, make their way towards the reactor with haste and begin working.

spans.text: The three little beings, overflowing with happiness, make their way towards the reactor with haste and begin working.

units.rawText: The daily repair life of a particular cold-faced individual and the three little sprites began thus.
units.displayText: The daily repair life of a particular cold-faced individual and the three little sprites began thus.

spans.text: The daily repair life of a particular cold-faced individual and the three little sprites began thus.

units.displayText: [ヽ(^ω^) ...Reactor access point successfully replaced!]

spans.text: [ヽ(^ω^) ...Reactor access point successfully replaced!]

spans.text: [ヽ(^ω^) Injecting repair program, system self-restoration progressing... current progress 2%.]

units.rawText: Et tu...
units.displayText: Et tu...

spans.text: Et tu...

units.rawText: Watching as Uranus is assimilated, Penumbra puts a palm to his forehead.
units.displayText: Watching as Uranus is assimilated, Penumbra puts a palm to his forehead.

spans.text: Watching as Uranus is assimilated, Penumbra puts a palm to his forehead.

units.rawText: Zzp... analyzing. Appropriate answer located. If resistance is futile, one might as well make the most of the situation.
units.displayText: Zzp... analyzing. Appropriate answer located. If resistance is futile, one might as well make the most of the situation.

spans.text: Zzp... analyzing. Appropriate answer located. If resistance is futile, one might as well make the most of the situation.

units.rawText: This is just routine work. I don't get all the cheer.
units.displayText: This is just routine work. I don't get all the cheer.

spans.text: This is just routine work. I don't get all the cheer.

units.rawText: [<( ￣^￣)> No, this is no routine work.]
units.displayText: [<( ￣^￣)> No, this is no routine work.]

spans.text: [<( ￣^￣)> No, this is no routine work.]

units.rawText: The little robot turns around, seriously gazing at Penumbra.
units.displayText: The little robot turns around, seriously gazing at Penumbra.

spans.text: The little robot turns around, seriously gazing at Penumbra.

units.rawText: [(●'◡'●) It's new work, new work!]
units.displayText: [(●'◡'●) It's new work, new work!]

spans.text: [(●'◡'●) It's new work, new work!]

units.rawText: [(･_-｡ ) If there's no new work, we'll be nothing more than lazy slobs, doing the same things over and over again.]
units.displayText: [(･_-｡ ) If there's no new work, we'll be nothing more than lazy slobs, doing the same things over and over again.]

spans.text: [(･_-｡ ) If there's no new work, we'll be nothing more than lazy slobs, doing the same things over and over again.]

units.rawText: [(ﾉ´д｀) After the Arche Pyr was ignited, we had no more work to do, and had no right to eat chocolates.]
units.displayText: [(ﾉ´д｀) After the Arche Pyr was ignited, we had no more work to do, and had no right to eat chocolates.]

spans.text: [(ﾉ´д｀) After the Arche Pyr was ignited, we had no more work to do, and had no right to eat chocolates.]

units.rawText: [(；へ：) And the days without chocolates are difficult indeed...]
units.displayText: [(；へ：) And the days without chocolates are difficult indeed...]

spans.text: [(；へ：) And the days without chocolates are difficult indeed...]

units.rawText: The formerly jaunty trio suddenly fell into a deep melancholy.
units.displayText: The formerly jaunty trio suddenly fell into a deep melancholy.

spans.text: The formerly jaunty trio suddenly fell into a deep melancholy.

units.rawText: The assassin with not a clue how to comfort people finds himself out of his depth, and Uranus pats him on the shoulder.
units.displayText: The assassin with not a clue how to comfort people finds himself out of his depth, and Uranus pats him on the shoulder.

spans.text: The assassin with not a clue how to comfort people finds himself out of his depth, and Uranus pats him on the shoulder.

units.rawText: So you have new work because of the damage caused by the Entropic invasion?
units.displayText: So you have new work because of the damage caused by the Entropic invasion?

spans.text: So you have new work because of the damage caused by the Entropic invasion?

units.rawText: [(●'◡'●) Yeah, yeah!]
units.displayText: [(●'◡'●) Yeah, yeah!]

spans.text: [(●'◡'●) Yeah, yeah!]

units.rawText: [(●'◡'●) There'll be chocolates for rewards when we're done!]
units.displayText: [(●'◡'●) There'll be chocolates for rewards when we're done!]

spans.text: [(●'◡'●) There'll be chocolates for rewards when we're done!]

units.rawText: With the situation as is, we should finish the repairs together. I'd like to try Ms. Choco's chocolates too.
units.displayText: With the situation as is, we should finish the repairs together. I'd like to try Ms. Choco's chocolates too.

spans.text: With the situation as is, we should finish the repairs together. I'd like to try Ms. Choco's chocolates too.

units.rawText: Y... y... yay.
units.displayText: Y... y... yay.

spans.text: Y... y... yay.
